title: Jyotish: the Science of Light
oneLine: The foundations of Jyotish, the Vedic science of light: the sidereal sky and its nine grahas, the twenty-seven lunar mansions, and the five-limbed almanac.
description: Jyotish is a living sacred tradition and one of the oldest continuous ways of reading the sky. This course teaches its foundations in three modules, each with three lessons and a quiz: the sidereal sky and the nine grahas; the nakshatras, the Moon's twenty-seven mansions; and the panchanga, the almanac of the day. Study it here or walk it in Jyotisha Loka, where the grahas wheel overhead where they truly stand tonight.
notice: This course teaches the foundations of Jyotish: its astronomy as astronomy and its teachings as tradition. It gives no readings, predictions or remedies.
